name: AIC重型
effect: 装备者HP+500。装备者击败敌人后，恢复100HP。效果触发冷却：5秒。
effectEn: Wearer's HP +500. After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer restores 100 HP. Effect trigger cooldown: 5s.

name: AIC轻型
effect: 装备者HP+500。装备者击败敌人后，ATK+20，持续5秒。
effectEn: Wearer's HP +500. After the wearer defeats an enemy, the wearer gains ATK +20 for 5s.

name: 装甲MSGR
effect: 装备者STR+50。当装备者HP低于50%时，获得30%全伤害减免。
effectEn: Wearer's Strength +50. When the wearer's HP is below 50%, the wearer gains 30% DMG Reduction against all types of damage.

name: 漫游MSGR
effect: 装备者AGL+50。当装备者HP高于80%时，Physical DMG+20%。
effectEn: Wearer's Agility +50. When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Physical DMG +20%.

name: 莫德伏绝缘
effect: 装备者INT+50。当装备者HP高于80%时，Arts DMG+20%。
effectEn: Wearer's Intellect +50. When the wearer's HP is above 80%, Arts DMG +20%.

name: 莫德伏抗性
effect: 装备者WIL+50。当装备者HP低于50%时，Treatment Effect+30%。
effectEn: Wearer's Will +50. When the wearer's HP is below 50%, Treatment Effect +30%.

name: 阿伯雷遗产
effect: 装备者Skill DMG+24%。施放战技、连携技或终结技时，ATK+5%，持续15秒。三种技能类型的增益独立且不叠加。
effectEn: Wearer's Skill DMG +24%. When the wearer casts a battle skill, combo skill, or ultimate, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 15s. The buff from each of the three skill types is unique and does not stack with itself.

name: 灾变
effect: 装备者Ultimate Gain Efficiency+20%。施放战技时，SP回复+50。每场战斗仅触发1次。
effectEn: Wearer's Ultimate Gain Efficiency +20%. The wearer casts a battle skill, the action returns +50 SP. This effect only triggers 1 time per battle.

name: 剑术师
effect: 装备者Stagger Efficiency Bonus+20%。施加Physical Status后，造成一次250%ATK的Physical DMG和10 Stagger。冷却15秒。
effectEn: Wearer's Stagger Efficiency Bonus +20%. After the wearer applies a Physical Status, the wearer also performs 1 hit that deals +250% ATK of Physical DMG and 10 Stagger. Effect trigger cooldown: 15s.

name: LYNX
effect: 装备者HP Treatment Efficiency+20%。治疗后目标获得15%全伤害减免10秒。溢出治疗量提升至30%。
effectEn: Wearer's HP Treatment Efficiency +20%. After the wearer gives HP treatment to an allied target, that target also gains +15% DMG Reduction for 10s. If the treatment exceeds the target's Max HP, the target gains +30% DMG Reduction.

name: 源石技艺
effect: 装备者ATK+8%。施加Vulnerable后，Physical DMG+8%持续15秒，可叠4层。目标已有4层Vulnerable时，额外Physical DMG+16%持续10秒。
effectEn: Wearer's ATK +8%. After the wearer applies Vulnerability, the wearer gains Physical DMG +8% for 15s. This effect can reach 4 stacks. If the target already has 4 stacks of Vulnerability, the wearer gains an additional Physical DMG +16% for 10s.

name: 碎骨者
effect: 装备者ATK+15%。施放连携技时获得1层Bonekrushing Smash，使下一次战技DMG+30%。最多叠2层。
effectEn: Wearer's ATK +15%. When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Bonekrushing Smash that grants the wearer's next battle skill DMG Dealt +30%. Can stack 2 times.

name: 脉冲实验室
effect: 装备者Arts Intensity+30。施加Electrification后Electric DMG+50%持续10秒；施加Solidification后Cryo DMG+50%持续10秒。不可叠加。
effectEn: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. After the wearer applies Electrification, the wearer gains Electric DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Solidification, the wearer gains Cryo DMG +50% for 10s.

name: 前线
effect: 装备者Combo Skill CD Reduction+15%。技能回复SP后，全队DMG+16%持续15秒。不可叠加。
effectEn: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%. After the wearer's skill recovers SP, the team gains DMG +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

name: 热工
effect: 装备者Arts Intensity+30。施加Combustion后Heat DMG+50%持续10秒；施加Corrosion后Nature DMG+50%持续10秒。不可叠加。
effectEn: Wearer's Arts Intensity +30. After the wearer applies Combustion, the wearer gains Heat DMG +50% for 10s. After the wearer applies Corrosion, the wearer gains Nature DMG +50% for 10s.

name: MI安保
effect: 装备者CRIT Rate+5%。暴击后ATK+5%持续5秒，可叠5层。满层时额外CRIT Rate+5%。
effectEn: Wearer's Critical Rate +5%. After the wearer scores a critical hit, the wearer gains ATK +5% for 5s. This effect can reach 5 stacks. At max stacks, grant an additional Critical Rate +5%.

name: 50型应龙
effect: 装备者ATK+15%。队伍中任意角色施放战技时，获得1层Yinglung's Edge，使下一次连携技DMG+20%。最多叠3层。
effectEn: Wearer's ATK +15%. When any operator in the team casts a battle skill, the wearer gains 1 stack of Yinglung's Edge that gives DMG +20% to the wearer's next combo skill. Can stack 3 times.

name: 潮涌
effect: 装备者Skill DMG+20%。施加2层以上Arts Infliction后，Arts DMG+35%持续15秒。不可叠加。
effectEn: Wearer's Skill DMG Dealt +20%. After the wearer applies 2 or more stacks of Arts Infliction on the enemy, the wearer gains Arts DMG Dealt +35% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

name: 永恒锡兰石
effect: 装备者HP+1000。施加Amp/Protect/Susceptibility/Weaken时，其他队友DMG+16%持续15秒。不可叠加。
effectEn: Wearer's HP +1000. After the wearer applies Amp, Protected, Susceptibility, or Weakened, other teammates gain DMG Dealt +16% for 15s. This effect cannot stack.

name: 清波
effect: 装备者Combo Skill CD Reduction+15%。施放连携技时，Skill DMG+20%（所有技能）持续15秒，可叠2层。
effectEn: Wearer's Combo Skill Cooldown Reduction +15%. When the wearer casts a combo skill, the wearer gains Skill DMG Dealt +20% (for every skill) for 15s. This effect can reach 2 stacks.

name: 锡兰流
effect: 装备者ATK+10%。消耗Electrification或Corrosion时，获得层数等于Status Level的增益，每层Electric/Nature DMG+15%持续25秒。最多3层。
effectEn: Wearer's ATK +10%. Whenever the wearer consumes Electrification or Corrosion, the wearer gains buff stacks equal to the Status Level, with each stack giving Electric and Nature DMG +15% for 25s. Max 3 stacks.

name: 苍刃
effect: 装备者ATK+8%。施加Crush或Breach时，Physical DMG+[6%×消耗的Vulnerable层数]持续20秒。目标有Physical Susceptibility/Stagger/Originium Crystal时提升至1.5倍。
effectEn: Wearer's ATK +8%. When the wearer applies Crush or Breach, the wearer gains Physical DMG Dealt +[6% × number of Vulnerability stacks consumed] for 20s. If the target has Physical Susceptibility, is Staggered, or has Originium Crystals, increase to 1.5 times.
